messages:
olivia_h: FYI — UX Research Engineer candidate (Anya S.) is confirmed for a hybrid loop on Tue 2026-04-07. In-person time 11:00–15:00 PT, then remote panel 15:30–17:00 PT. Need ops help: meeting room, badge, loaner laptop, lunch voucher, travel stipend, and accessibility notes.
ben_k: timezone check — is Anya in PST or EST? calendar shows PST.
olivia_h: Anya is in PST (San Diego). All times are PT.
priya: Got it. I can handle badge + lunch vouchers. Any dietary restrictions?
olivia_h: Candidate is pescatarian and prefers gluten-free options.
peopleops_bot: [checklist created] Onsite checklist: room booking, badge, loaner device, parking code, lunch voucher, reimbursement form link.
ben_k: Room request — can we reserve Conf C (ground floor) 10:45–15:15 for buffer? Conf C has A/V and wheelchair access.
sam_p: I'll create a Zoom fallback room and private channel for remote panelists. Zoom link: https://zoom.redwood.example/j/987654321. Will post to thread once created.
mike_r: Heads up — candidate asked about local parking reimbursement. What's the expense code?
priya: Expense code OPS-INT-TRAVEL. Reimbursement cap $60 for local parking; keep receipts.
olivia_h: Parking: use lot B, kiosk code 47-11 to validate. Badge pick-up at Reception — bring government ID.
candidate_portal: Hi team — Anya received the candidate packet. Please ask them to upload ID and signed NDA here: https://portal.redwood.example/upload (deadline: 48h before loop).
ben_k: Loaner laptop — need Dev VM with Chrome + Zoom, local admin for test devices. Can IT push M1 Macbook image?
priya: We have a 13" M2 loaner available. IT will pre-stage user account and Wi-Fi.
sam_p: Zoom room created and invited: https://zoom.redwood.example/j/987654321 passcode: loop2026. Channel #interview-anya created for panel comms.
peopleops_bot: Calendar invite sent to panelists and candidate. Invite ID: 1936543210-UX-ANYA. Reminder set 24h and 30m prior.
olivia_h: Panel schedule attached in calendar. Remote-only panelists: @ben_k (NY), @sam_p (SF), @taylor_pm (remote) — start at 15:30 PT.
ben_k: Quick ask — can we reserve a quiet room with HDMI for candidate pairing task? 14:00–15:00 PT.
priya: Conf B is free and has HDMI. Reserving it now.
mike_r: Also confirming travel stipend: we approved $150 for candidate travel (to be paid as pre-arrival Venmo/ACH). Who will coordinate payout?
priya: I can coordinate payout. Please DM me candidate payment details; we'll only use those for stipend.
olivia_h: Accessibility note — candidate requested a breakout room with extra lighting and noise-cancelling headphones for test task. Can ops confirm availability?
peopleops_bot: Accessibility accommodations logged. Equipment: noise-cancelling headphones can be checked out from front desk. Lighting: portable lamp available.
sam_p: One more: please ensure interview recordings are off and panelists mute when not speaking.
olivia_h: Affirmed. Also planning 10-min buffer between interviews for notes.
priya: Lunch vouchers — sending digital voucher redeemable at cafe/ordering app. Will share codes by EOD with recruiter.
ben_k: For onsite machine access: add candidate user to 'guest' group, limit to necessary apps. IT to confirm before arrival.
priya: IT confirmed guest account will be ready on loaner.
mike_r: Candidate asked about background check timeline — we usually do post-offer. Told them that's standard.
olivia_h: Thanks team. Small note: candidate prefers a video-only intro with hiring manager — skip handshake if they prefer.
priya: Noted. We'll include that in front desk instructions.
peopleops_bot: Reminder scheduled: send arrival instructions to candidate 24h before loop.
olivia_h: Perfect — anything else?
ben_k: Can someone post the on-call number in #interview-anya for day-of issues?
sam_p: Posted: @here day-of ops contact is +1-415-555-0123 (Ellie).
olivia_h: Great, thanks everyone :raised_hands:
mike_r: Thanks — recruiter will confirm candidate arrival ETA tomorrow.
